question.text: Crime / Fidelity insurance for a Cat III AIF covers:

answer.text: Employee dishonesty, fraud, theft of fund assets

explanation.text: The Logic: Crime / Fidelity insurance is an operational-risk insurance line specifically designed to cover losses arising from employee dishonesty, internal fraud, embezzlement and theft of fund assets by the manager's own personnel. It is distinct from cyber liability (which covers data breaches and cyber incidents), health insurance, and auto insurance, which respond to entirely different perils. The Trap: Cyber risk is the closest tempting distractor because both involve "wrongful" acts, but cyber policies cover external/digital incidents whereas Crime/Fidelity is targeted at internal personnel acts of dishonesty. Note: The NISM Series XIX-B AIF (Category III) Distributors workbook insurance section pages checked describe Professional Indemnity/E&O, D&O liability and key-man insurance but do not separately enumerate Crime/Fidelity insurance covering employee dishonesty, fraud or theft of fund assets; the framing above reflects general fund-operational-insurance industry practice rather than a workbook citation.
